_help: kind: fix|report. target: local|pr (pr = will become a PR; report = findings only). Evidence kinds: path:line (code), config:path:line, deploy:path:line, sha:<commit>, cmd:<file with command + output, relative to repo or evidence dir>, owner:<who, when, where>, prod:<observation>. Claims with affects_prod=true need at least one of owner:/config:/deploy:/sha:/cmd:/prod: — a code reference alone never proves what runs in production.
